brief:
Israeli occupation forces raided the town of Al-Khader south of Bethlehem on Wednesday evening, Shehab Wire reported. The incursion came as part of ongoing military operations across Palestinian territories in the West Bank. Troops entered the town and conducted searches, though no immediate details emerged regarding the scope or stated purpose of the operation.

In a separate incident during the same period, occupation forces arrested a youth in the northern West Bank city of Tulkarm. The arrest underscored a pattern of detention sweeps that have accelerated across Palestinian population centers in recent months. Israeli military operations typically involve house-to-house searches and the apprehension of individuals, actions that Palestinian officials and rights groups have repeatedly condemned as collective punishment.
